configuration.domain_rule: 10th percentile of development OOF nearest-neighbor Tanimoto; heuristic only
configuration.threshold_selection: maximize pooled out-of-fold development F1; not tuned on test

dataset.assay_name: Confirmatory Screen:  Chemical Inhibitors of TNF alpha stimulated E Selectin expression
dataset.cell_model: Primary human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVEC)
dataset.endpoint: Confirmed inhibition of TNF-alpha-induced E-selectin expression in primary HUVEC screen at nominal 2 uM
dataset.label_definition: PubChem Active/Inactive screen outcome; the depositor protocol states that a >30% inhibition threshold was used in hit selection.
limitations: Single historical HUVEC assay and one endpoint; not a general vascular-response measurement.
Compounds were selected from an earlier primary-screen hit set, so the dataset is selection-biased.
The endpoint is a confirmatory assay hit label at 2 uM, not safety, efficacy, clinical outcome, or dose-response.
PubChem metadata does not state a dataset license; verify source-specific rights before redistribution or commercial use.
dataset.protocol_summary: Compound pre-incubation 1 hour, followed by 4 hours of 60 ng/mL TNF-alpha challenge; triplicate normalized percent inhibition is reported for the confirmatory screen.
dataset.redistribution_note: The PubChem assay record does not specify a dataset license in its retrieved metadata. The record is publicly retrievable; verify depositor-specific rights before redistribution or commercial use. Source attribution is retained.

metrics.endpoint: Confirmed inhibition of TNF-alpha-induced E-selectin expression in primary HUVEC screen at nominal 2 uM
metrics.reliability_decision: Not eligible: the single-assay data are strongly imbalanced and selected from a prior primary-screen hit set; the raw, uncalibrated score Brier value did not improve on the prevalence baseline, and the test contains only ten active examples. Keep scores exploratory and abstain from claiming a reliable vascular prediction.

prediction_policy: No calibrated or validated vascular prediction is available. A similarity-qualified model score is a non-actionable exploratory ranking signal only. Never map it into fluid-mechanics parameters.
